policy: Retain highest available actual-reward and final saved epoch per independently identifiable hand/object/axis/reward training version. Deduplicate identical full-state payloads. Preserve singletons and non-checkpoint files. Do not change save policy or separate multi_camera_transfer project.
notes: last_mean_rewards on periodic saves is historical best, not the reward of those weights.
Some older canonical best weights were overwritten by previous training; retain best surviving checkpoint. Missing weights cannot be recreated.
Shared Z canonical is restored 75mm; 85mm centered best is separately archived; both are retained.
Shared Y contains separate Oct29/Oct30 training versions; retain each version separately.
multi_camera_transfer outputs already have best.pt and last.pt per run; no changes needed.
